paragraphs.text: The Cave of Light was a structure built around the White Lacuna , one of a series of tunnels that led to Mirrodin's Core . It was located at the base of Taj-Nar .

Legend tells that the leonin clerics , called abunas, focus their faith and cause the white sun to rise every day. The lacunae were created by the rising of the five suns from the Mana Core, a large ball of mana in the very center of the plane. Both the leonin and the Auriok held it as a holy place of divine revelation. It delivered powerful visions said to come from the white sun.
